name: TA: Chaos Space's Arm and Core units
summary: The units TA: Chaos Space 0.8 adds to Arm and Core, on their builders' menus.
notes: Input is TA: Chaos Space 0.8 by BlueBurst (2005), as TAUniverse hosts it (Chaos Space.zip, 10 January 2008). Its Rhyoss is Monolithic Inc.'s race, rebuilt by BlueBurst on Switeck's BugFix 1.7 beta; its TotalAR.exe, totala.ini and fix scripts are not used.
The units keep the stats TA: Chaos Space gave them; its changes to Arm and Core's own units are not carried.
